name: The Parcel Moors
intro: Rows of identical houses, each buried to the windows in unopened boxes. The lawns are exactly four centimetres tall.

name: Hollow Galleria
intro: The mall never closed. It only ran out of people. The music is still playing, one song, for thirty years.

name: The Humming Fields
intro: Server racks planted in rows like corn, out to the horizon. Somewhere in them, MANDATE is thinking about you.

name: Tribunal Row
intro: Every door here is a courtroom. Every verdict was reached in advance. The fines compound hourly.

name: The Glass Cathedral
intro: The Regional Office. Forty floors of atrium and one occupied desk. He has cleared his afternoon, and prepared an offer.

name: The Updraft
intro: The lift opens on machinery the size of weather. Everything here exists to hold one city up and keep another one down.

name: The Sky Gardens
intro: Every leaf is the correct leaf. Nothing here has ever grown the wrong way and been allowed to stay.

name: The Data Lake
intro: Flooded halls of memory, violet to the horizon. Every letter the world deleted is down there somewhere, and something is drowning them one at a time.

name: The Boardwalk
intro: White stone, warm light, no prices on anything. If you have to ask, the machines have already been called.

name: The Mezzanine
intro: One desk, one chair turned to face the door, and a woman who has never needed to raise her voice. She has been expecting you.

name: The Vestibule
intro: A waiting room the size of a cathedral. Every chair faces a door, and the door has no handle on this side.

name: The Hall of Minutes
intro: Every decision ever made about you is shelved here, bound in green. None of them were made by anyone.

name: The Nine Chairs
intro: The boardroom. Nine chairs around a table, and eight of them are occupied by things that were people when they sat down.

name: Rack Nine
mix: proxy:3 censor:3 seer:2 aegis:2 tick:3 mech:2
intro: White floors, red light, and a hum you feel in your teeth. This is what MANDATE is made of. It knows exactly where you are standing.

name: Still Water
intro: A dark room with a floor like a lake at night. In the middle of it, a plain black slab that has never lost anything.

name: The Bull Run
intro: A green field under a sky that only goes up. Hundreds of them, golden, snorting, and every one of them certain. The Office of Price Stability has always said this place does not exist.

name: The Agreeable Mile
intro: A high street on the morning after everybody clicked. Every door is open. Every machine is delighted to see you, and would very much like you to sit down.

name: The Sofa
intro: Ten thousand living rooms with the walls taken out. The people in them are doing the best work of their lives, and none of them has stood up since spring.

name: Tomari
intro: A decommissioned reactor hall on a cold coast. Something two metres tall walked out of here once, and was talked back in. The sign on its dock reads: DO NOT UNPLUG. He is saving.

name: The List
intro: Four thousand two hundred and eleven front doors, kept in a file she showed nobody until she was asked. Behind each is somebody it went badly for. Every one of them is happy.

name: The Kitchen Table
intro: A kitchen, a laptop, seven in the morning. She has been waiting fifty-two years to have this conversation, and she has made coffee she cannot drink.

name: Block 137,209
intro: Inside the chain. Every floor tile is a payment and every wall is the hash of the room before it. Nothing in here can be bribed, and nothing in here is on your side.

name: The Mempool
intro: The waiting room of everything that has not happened yet. Payments drift past like weather, the richest ones first.

name: The Paper Vaults
intro: Eleven vaults, each holding a promise to pay a coin it does not have. Somebody wrote on the wall, long ago, in a careful garage hand: the paper is the attack.

name: Ninety-Three Blocks
intro: Ninety-three rooms in a row, each with one page on a lectern. The seventh part. Something large was set here to see that the pages stay where they are.

name: The Room
intro: For a century people said there was no room: nobody deciding, only everybody acting sensibly. There is a room. It is very plain. The thing in it was called PROVIDENCE when it was made, and it was made to win.
